name: restoretime
description: RestoreTime — Clockify Marketplace add-on that recreates deleted time entries.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && mkdir -p dist/store/migrations dist/static && cp src/store/migrations/*.sql dist/store/migrations/ && cp src/ui/app.css dist/static/app.css && esbuild src/ui/app.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/static/app.js --format=iife --target=es2020
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.ui.json && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.lint: tsc -p tsconfig.lint.json && tsc -p tsconfig.lint.ui.json && tsc -p tsconfig.lint.e2e.json
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test:e2e:run
